'''Gap Nox''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion]], who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the [[Battle of Moorja (Clone Wars)|Battle of Moorja]], Nox became a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]],<ref name="SWI147" /> and in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="TNEC" /> accompanied Gunray to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] had its [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|stronghold]].<ref name="RotS" />

Nox and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Fame Drimal/Legends|Fame Drimal]] were stationed next the entrance of the [[Separatist Council war room|war room]], to the left and right respectively,<ref name="FB">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsSourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-devious-neimoidians/676129629103814|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=2014-01-19|quote=Fame Dremal is the guard on the right side of the door (as seen from inside the bunker), Gap Nox is the guard on the left.|archivefile=File:NeimoidiansFacebook.pdf}}</ref> where the CIS leadership was waiting when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the newly-appointed [[Sith apprentice/Legends|pupil]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], arrived. Sidious, a secret ally of the Separatists, however, [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|betrayed]] them and Vader [[Death/Legends|slaughtered]] all present, including Nox and Gunray. Nox had [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin. They [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] Neimoidian guard [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and were armed with a [[Neimoidian ceremonial blaster rifle/Legends|Neimoidian ceremonial blaster rifle]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gap Nox first appeared as an unnamed background character in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="RotS" /> The scenes involving Drimal and Nox were shot on Stage 7 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 8]], [[2003]]. The two Neimoidians, portrayed by [[Dean Gould]] and [[Christopher Mitchell]], were filmed being cut down at the doorway by Skywalker's actor [[Hayden Christensen]],<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> although this shot was cut from the final film.<ref name="RotS" /> [[2014|Nine years later]], Nox was identified in the [[Star Wars Insider 147|''Star Wars Insider'' 147]] article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|The Devious Neimoidians Revealed]]" by [[Tim Veekhoven]], [[Kevin Beentjes]], [[Sander de Lange]], and [[Leland Chee]].<ref name="SWI147" /> The character was specified further in the endnotes for the article included in the [[Wikipedia:Facebook|Facebook]] page [https://www.facebook.com/StarWarsSourcebooks Star Wars Sourcebooks], which was also run by the first three authors.<ref name="FB" />
